status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 129% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 129 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, intensifying fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own conflict escalates, and Somaliland and Puntland were designated as "friendly" in an Israeli security framework. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and has agreed to acquire Pakistani JF‑17 fighter jets. The UCDP recorded 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
